name: unchained_berserker_cannot_be_enchanted_by_a_white_aura_but_can_by_others
notes: Printed: 'Protection from white (This creature can't be ... enchanted ... by anything white.)'. The white Aura Pacifism cast on the Berserker is refused; the green Aura Oakenform ({2}{G}, +3/+3) on the Berserker resolves and stays attached: the 1/1 becomes 4/4. Seat 0 has the mana for both, so the refusal is about the target.
